newsitem.title: HONG KONG: S&P rates Jasindo claims-paying ability BBB.
newsitem.headline: S&P rates Jasindo claims-paying ability BBB.

text.p: Standard & Poor's on Friday said it had assigned a first-time BBB claims-paying ability rating to Indonesian insurer PT Asuransi Jasa Indonesia (Jasindo).

"The rating reflects Jasindo's leading market position, good financial structure, profitable earnings track record and the benefits of ownership by the government of the Republic of Indonesia," S&P said in a statement.

But the rating was "moderated" by Jasindo's investment asset quality and perceived industry risk associated with the Indonesian insurance industry's current stage of evolution and planned deregulation, it added.
